title: Environment-driven rollout gates for multi-mode model orchestration
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Build deployment gating primitives that express environment-specific constraints and translate high-level lifecycle intents (canary, A/B, shadow, auto-rollback) into concrete orchestration actions across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Scope: gating layer, environment capability discovery, constraint templates, reconciliation logic, and operator-visible audit logs. Out of scope: persistent UI redesign (Console changes tracked separately) and new network fabric for Private—this ticket focuses on control-plane semantics and runtime hooks. Motivation: customers run mixed environments and expect consistent rollout semantics but each environment has different constraints (e.g., Dedicated pools: strict capacity reservations; Private: limited rolling window due to maintenance windows and strict RBAC; Hosted: flexible burst, global routing). We must avoid one-size-fits-all rollout that either violates tenant isolation or creates unpredictable latency/cost spikes. Deliverables: DSL for gates, environment capability registry, adapter implementations for existing router and rollout engines, end-to-end e2e tests, rollout audit trail format, and an ops runbook for common rollback scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: A DSL (YAML) that can express: max-percent-canary, steady-state-duration, shadow-only routing, request-sampling rules, SLO thresholds for automatic rollback
Adapters for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private that translate DSL to platform-specific actions (routing updates, capacity checks, RBAC checks, scheduled windows)
Automated canary job that fails fast when latency or error-rate breaches configured SLOs and triggers documented auto-rollback flow
E2E tests that run simulated A/B tests and shadow traffic scenarios against a staging fleet for each environment type
Audit logs produced for each rollout event with enough context to reconstruct decisions (who, when, gates evaluated, metrics snapshot)
Runbook validated by SRE and PM with at least one tabletop drill completed
steps: Design DSL and capability model (owner: Priya)
Implement environment capability registry and discovery endpoints (owner: infra)
Wire DSL to existing rollout controller; add gate evaluation hooks
Implement SLO evaluation module used by canary jobs and auto-rollback
Add audit logging and link to tracing/dashboard
Run e2e tests and tabletop drill, iterate on failure modes
Prepare ops runbook and handoff to SRE/solutions engineering
